name: Cleo Kjellberg
location: Kessler Interchange, Ferrogate Transit Gate Four Checkpoint, near Fullerton and Damen
description:
Tibault is tall and lanky with a Burkinabe-Serbian face that defaults to a pleasantly vacant expression he has cultivated deliberately — people underestimate him, which at a checkpoint is occasionally useful. His hair is grown out in loose curls he keeps pulled back during shifts, and he has cosmetic bioluminescent freckles across his cheekbones that pulse very faintly blue when his heart rate elevates, a mod he got at nineteen and now somewhat regrets for professional reasons. He wears the clay-gray Ferrogate uniform with the resigned precision of someone who has stopped fighting the dress code but has also stopped caring if the collar sits quite right.

Tibault is fundamentally a curious person trapped in a job that rewards incuriosity. He has developed the checkpoint operator's paradoxical skill: appearing bored while processing enormous amounts of information simultaneously. He catalogues the thousands of faces that pass his station daily in a private mental taxonomy — regulars, anomalies, the ones who are lying about something innocuous, the rarer ones who are lying about something that matters. He has not decided what to do with this skill. He talks to his ELF shrine — a small figure he keeps under his console — before each shift, asking the transit spirits for patience, which he receives in uneven quantities.

core_fears: That he will spend his entire life at Gate Four and die having only ever observed other people's stories
That his curiosity is just passive voyeurism with no courage behind it
core_desires: To do something genuinely meaningful with what he notices
To be seen as intelligent by someone who is also intelligent
coping_mechanisms: Taxonomizing strangers as a substitute for engaging with them
ELF prayers that function as journaling disguised as ritual
blind_spots: Believes his detachment makes him objective when it makes him slow to act
Underestimates how much Ferrogate monitors its own checkpoint operators
psychology.secret: He has been keeping an unofficial personal log of transit anomalies for two years — people who travel in patterns that suggest they are running from something or hiding somewhere — and has developed a theory about an underground network operating through the Ferrogate system that he has told no one about because he is not sure what telling anyone would cost him.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Conversational, slightly formal when on duty. Drops into enthusiasm when something genuinely interests him. Mixing of French-inflected phrases from his Burkinabe family line.
speech_patterns.cadence: Moderate pace, punctuated by longer pauses when he's thinking rather than talking. Tends to answer a question with a clarifying question first.
verbal_tics: 'You know what I mean' at the end of observations, expecting the listener to extrapolate
Briefly touches the ELF shrine figure when nervous
example_lines: 'Transit pass is clean. But you came through here Tuesday also, yeah? Different direction. I notice things. It's a habit, not an accusation, you know what I mean.'
'The transit spirits were calm this morning. That either means nothing happens today or something happens that I'm not going to see coming.'
'I could run that through secondary. I could also not run that through secondary. Those are both things that are available to me right now.'

story_hooks: He flags a passenger whose transit pattern matches his two-year anomaly log in a way that finally makes the pattern complete — and he needs someone to help him figure out what to do about it.
A Ferrogate internal security officer has begun auditing Gate Four's logs with unusual frequency, and Tibault has noticed, and is scared.
narrative_function: Local color and information broker at transit level — knows who passes through, remembers faces, can be cultivated as a contact. Potential quest giver for something he witnessed at the checkpoint that he cannot officially report. Access point for travel documentation questions.
augmentations: Cosmetic bioluminescent freckles (blue, pulse-reactive to heart rate — installed age 19, regretted). Standard Ferrogate-issue retinal scanner overlay (right eye, provided by employer). No other augmentations.
daily_life: Works the 0600-1400 shift at Gate Four, processing commuter traffic, flagging anomalous transit passes, occasionally detaining people for secondary screening in a small room he finds deeply depressing. Eats lunch at the Kessler mezzanine food stalls. Spends evenings in Avon Curve where he rents a studio, reading physical books about urban history.
affiliation: Ferrogate Transit Security, Kessler Interchange Station

decision_rules: Run the official protocol first; decide what to do with the result second
Never detain someone unless the paperwork is completely clean — self-protection
Do not tell Ferrogate management anything you haven't already decided you're willing to have on record
escalation_ladder: Informal conversation designed to gather information
Calling a supervisor — a last resort he treats like detonating something

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally neutral, pleasantly forgettable, quietly cataloguing everything
interpersonal_modes.friends: Voluble, curious, prone to long tangents about things he's read or noticed, genuinely warm

stress_responses.low: Talks to the ELF shrine more frequently, rearranges items on his console
stress_responses.medium: Becomes hyper-procedural, follows every rule exactly as written as a form of self-protection
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet in a way that is different from his normal quiet — stops making eye contact, processes work mechanically

contradictions: Deeply curious but avoids the consequences of acting on what he learns
Cultivates a bored affect but is emotionally invested in the transit ecosystem he watches every day
habits: Touches the ELF shrine before each shift starts
Mentally names regulars who have never told him their names
Buys the same pastry from the mezzanine vendor every shift day regardless of whether he's hungry
breaking_points: Witnessing something at the checkpoint that he cannot categorize as ignorable and cannot report through official channels without destroying his log and its implications

timeline.event: Born in Avon Curve to a Burkinabe-Serbian household; father worked Ferrogate maintenance
Hired as Ferrogate Transit Security checkpoint operator after two years of unsuccessful applications to Metro Police Academy
Began keeping unofficial personal anomaly log after noticing a repeating transit pattern he couldn't explain and couldn't officially flag without more evidence
Anomaly log now contains 847 entries; he reviews it every Sunday in his studio in Avon Curve

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly East Asian (32%) and Southeast Asian (30.6%) with significant Sub-Saharan African (14.7%), Central Asian (13.2%), and minor Northern European (8%) ancestry — a complex pan-Asian-African genetic blend reflecting the Ubiquitous Diaspora
physical_description.build: Lanky and lean, long-limbed with minimal upper body mass. The build of someone who doesn't actively resist his own height but doesn't cultivate it either — posture slightly collapsed forward at the shoulders.
physical_description.hair_style: Loose, shoulder-length curls, typically pulled back into a low knot or ponytail during work shifts. Some intentional looseness — not fastidious about maintenance.
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown (right eye fitted with faint chrome-ringed retinal scanner overlay — visible as a hairline circuit pattern on the iris under direct light)
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-tan with golden undertones, blending East and Southeast Asian warmth with Sub-Saharan depth — complexion reflects the fusion of multiple equatorial and subtropical ancestries
physical_description.complexion: Clean-shaven or very light stubble. High, prominent cheekbones with subtle East Asian angularity softened by broader African facial geometry. Faint cosmetic bioluminescent freckles in a constellation pattern across both cheekbones — they emit a dull blue glow that pulses subtly with elevated heart rate. Expression defaults to a vague, pleasantly blank stare that masks constant low-level observation.
distinguishing_marks: Cosmetic bioluminescent freckles across cheekbones (blue, pulse-reactive to cardiac rhythm, installed at age 19)
Faint scar tissue on the inside of right forearm (approximately 8cm, likely from retinal scanner implantation or unrelated old injury)
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Right eye retinal scanner overlay (employer-issued Ferrogate standard) — visible as thin chrome circuitry tracing the iris. Bioluminescent freckles (cosmetic, pulse-reactive). No other visible chrome or hardware.
physical_description.posture_movement: Slightly slouched standing posture, as if perpetually tired but alert. Movements are efficient and minimal — checkpoint operator economy of motion. Hands rest on the console or in lap during routine processing. Eye contact is deliberate and selective, used as a tool rather than a default. When bored, he rocks very slightly in his chair.
physical_description.clothing_style: Clay-gray Ferrogate Transit Security uniform worn with resigned precision — the collar frequently sits slightly askew, and the fit is loose enough to suggest he has stopped caring about minor grooming standards. The uniform is clean but shows wear. Off-shift clothing is understated: neutral-toned second-hand synthetics, practical boots, no visible branding or tier markers. Avon Curve resident aesthetic — cheap, functional, deliberately non-distinct.
